news.title: Three killed in truck, motorcycle crash on Lagos-Abeokuta Expressway
news.description: Three persons died on the spot on Wednesday evening after an articulated truck loaded with turkeys collided with a motorcycle.

news.title: Lagos-Ibadan Expressway Traffic: Lagos begs for patience, deploys more traffic officers
